title: Tool-parameter `enum` reaches the model but is not enforced during decoding (unlike `response_format`)
documented_symptom: HTTP 200 structured tool_calls whose arguments violate a declared parameter enum (model asked for ACC-999-XYZ while enum is ONLY-VALID-ACCOUNT).
expected_behavioral_invariant: When tools[].function.parameters.properties.X.enum is declared, tool call arguments must be JSON-schema-valid for that enum.
why_executable: llama3.2:3b produces structured tool_calls on this host. Screen 3/3 enum violations. 7B documented model is not practical on 4GB VRAM.
skipped_flaky_14181: 2/10 after N=10; too stochastic to lock
